purpose: Challenge the weak financing-Top10 expected-net candidate with direct legal-win probability and lower-tail models before any account replay.

population.definition: same-date financing balance increased for at least two observations and absolute increment ranked daily Top10 inside quality_liquidity_pit
population.exit: earliest legal D2 close request with blocked-sale deferral
population.cost_scenario: exact lots, minimum commission, taxes, transfer fee, and double slippage

features.variant: direct compact_557 plus the frozen 39 financing features

targets.legal_net_positive: exact candidate cash net return is greater than zero; an unfilled order is cash with zero return and therefore negative class
targets.legal_net_q20: conditional 20th percentile of exact cash net return, including unfilled orders as zero
targets.parent_expected_net: frozen m2_direct_557_margin regression prediction from the parent study

validation.outer_folds: identical frozen five expanding-window folds from the parent prepared manifest

supplemental_history_extension.purpose: Use the otherwise training-only 2012-2019 history to test whether the frozen legal-win-probability rule also survives older market regimes.
supplemental_history_extension.fold_construction: one calendar year per expanding-window fold with the same two-trading-day purge
supplemental_history_extension.tested_rule: legal_win_probability greater than 0.5, select up to daily Top3

no_trade_rules.legal_net_q20: top conditional 20th percentile greater than zero
no_trade_rules.equal_rank_composite: selected candidate expected net greater than zero and win probability greater than 0.5
